vectors.comment: Caesar with shift=13 is ROT13 — applying twice returns the original.
XYZ + shift 3 wraps past Z to ABC.
ABC + shift -3 wraps past A to XYZ.
Shift of zero is the identity transformation.
Shift larger than 26 normalizes via modulo (29 mod 26 = 3).
Non-ASCII characters pass through unchanged; only ASCII letters shift.
Decoding GHI with shift=3 recovers DEF (the input that produced GHI when encoded).
